races.name: Andy Calvert Celebration Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Bobby Socks
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 470 days off but has winning form on good going and tongue-tie applied

runners_data.name: Stay In The Game
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good recent form with trainer struggling but showed winning form last time out

runners_data.name: Zephlyn
runners_data.note: Strong each-way claims as hold-up horse with tongue-tie fitted and solid form figures on similar ground

runners_data.name: Les's Legacy
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer carrying tongue-tie and blinkers but facing stiff task off long absence

runners_data.name: Character Testing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with trainer in form and has place claims despite moderate recent efforts

runners_data.name: Newport
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who disappointed last time but has winning form at this level on good ground

runners_data.name: Curious Mrs Fox
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs to bounce back from disappointing effort 40 days ago

runners_data.name: National Question
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with two wins from last five starts but hasn't won for over two months

runners_data.name: Malangen
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner in good current form with useful apprentice claiming valuable weight allowance

runners_data.name: Snapaudaciaheros
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 35-day break wearing tongue-tie and cheekpieces for the first time

races.paceDynamic: Bobby Socks will lead from the front with Newport, National Question and Malangen providing prominent company in the early stages. This creates a sustainable pace rather than a cut-throat gallop, allowing the leaders to maintain their positions without being pressured by aggressive tactics. The moderate tempo will suit horses that can travel well in midfield before producing a finishing kick. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the even gallop and finish strongly up the hill at Hexham.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains moderate throughout allowing closers to finish
scenarios.body: The sustainable early gallop sets up perfectly for horses held up who can use their turn of foot in the final two furlongs. Stay In The Game and Zephlyn benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Bobby Socks and Newport maintain their advantage when the pace lifts
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run on their rivals and prove too strong when the race develops in earnest. Bobby Socks uses his class advantage while Newport's recent form suggests he can sustain his effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Surge Wins
scenarios.trigger: If horses tracking the leaders time their move perfectly
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows patient riders to position their mounts ideally before making decisive moves approaching the final hurdle. Character Testing and Curious Mrs Fox benefit from being close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too slow and bunch the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final bend where any horse with a clear run can win. This unpredictable finish could suit any runner who avoids trouble and gets a clean passage.

watchPoints.text: Bobby Socks needs close monitoring for ring rustiness after 470 days absence despite his class advantage
Stay In The Game and Zephlyn could clash for the same hold-up pitch if both wait too long to challenge
National Question's prominent style might see him caught between paces if the early gallop proves too slow
Character Testing and Curious Mrs Fox both need clear runs from their hold-up positions in a competitive handicap
Malangen's 11-year-old legs may struggle to maintain his prominent position over the testing Hexham finish

runners_data.name: All About Moi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 255-day break under trainer with poor recent record, but class horse who may need the run

runners_data.name: Mr Ramoon
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up horse with tendency to fade in finish, paired with inexperienced 5lb claimer making this a tough ask

runners_data.name: Ribble River
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get uncontested lead, wearing tongue-tie and has shown best form when controlling the pace

runners_data.name: Scopic
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from yard with poor recent record, limited experience on good going but should get ideal race setup

runners_data.name: Steps In Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with moderate recent form but trainer struggling, needs strong pace to be effective from the rear

runners_data.name: Colinski
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying valuable 3lb allowance with claimer, wearing pacifiers and showed improvement last time out

runners_data.name: Autumn Getaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 3lb claimer allowance but inconsistent recent form, may benefit from strong early pace

runners_data.name: Obsessedwithyou
runners_data.note: Proven prominent runner in excellent recent form with strong jockey booking, major threat if getting competitive early

races.paceDynamic: Ribble River will attempt to control proceedings from the front, with Nobotheratall and Obsessedwithyou likely to track the pace in prominent positions. With six hold-up horses in the field, there's genuine depth to the finish which could create a strong gallop if the prominent runners get competitive early. The single confirmed front-runner should get an uncontested lead, making this a pace that will strongly favor the hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks over this stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ribble River gets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes steady early
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get the perfect setup with plenty in hand for the finish, allowing them to unleash finishing kicks that the pace-setters cannot match. This suits the patient tactics of multiple runners who prefer to come from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Nobotheratall and Obsessedwithyou press Ribble River from early stages
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle develops that stretches the field and creates opportunities for horses that can race handily without getting involved in the early skirmishing. The strong early gallop sets up a tactical advantage for those just behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ribble River gets soft fractions and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front-runner to dictate terms completely and save enough energy for a decisive move. Hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up when the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent horses go too fast early and tie up badly
scenarios.body: The entire pace angle falls apart leaving only the most patient hold-up horses with any chance of finishing strongly. This extreme scenario favors only those who race stone-cold last and have proven stamina reserves.

watchPoints.text: Mr Ramoon faces a significant test with inexperienced claimer Jack Power taking over riding duties after poor recent efforts
All About Moi returns from 255-day absence for trainer Gary Hanmer who has managed just 0 wins from 10 runners in past fortnight
Ribble River's ability to get uncontested early fractions will determine whether hold-up horses get their preferred race shape
Multiple trainers including Ben Haslam and Philip Kirby are enduring poor spells with combined 0 wins from 32 recent runners
Six hold-up horses suggest the pace could develop into a genuine staying test if early leaders get pressed

races.name: Tileform Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Chicago Storm
runners_data.note: Front-running style with 55-day break should have him fresh, though trainer's poor 14-day record raises minor concern

runners_data.name: Ghasham
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who's been consistent in defeat recently, tongue-tie applied and quick return suggests readiness

runners_data.name: Bentley Road
runners_data.note: Unclear running style but Derek Fox booking adds professional angle, 35-day gap looks ideal for this grade

runners_data.name: Divas Doyen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping significantly in grade, pull-up last time forgiven given class drop and weight relief

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with claiming jockey taking valuable weight off, though trainer form remains worrying

runners_data.name: Cross Of Redmoor
runners_data.note: Closer returning from 179-day layoff with cheekpieces and tongue-tie, needs significant improvement

races.paceDynamic: Chicago Storm is the clear pace angle, likely to lead or track early with his prominent style and recent front-running form. With no obvious pace pressure from this field of predominantly hold-up horses (Ghasham, Mr Globalist, Cross Of Redmoor), Chicago Storm can dictate a steady rhythm through the early stages. The lack of early speed will create a tactical affair where the pace may not be strong enough to set up the closers. This race shape favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position handy and kick when the pace inevitably lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Chicago Storm gets an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to conserve energy and maintain his kick for home, while the hold-up horses struggle with insufficient pace to close into. His recent win at Sedgefield demonstrates he can capitalise when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and one closer gets the perfect run
scenarios.body: The tactical affair sets up perfectly for a patient ride, with the leader potentially stopping late as the field compresses. Ghasham's recent placed efforts suggest he's ready to strike in these conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bentley Road or Divas Doyen can track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: Their ability to sit closer than the hold-up horses but avoid the leader's fate gives them the tactical edge when the race develops. The handicapper may have underestimated their current form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Cross Of Redmoor's long absence masks significant improvement under patient handling
scenarios.body: The 179-day break could have freshened him completely, and trainer Quinlan's poor recent record might create value. The lack of pace perfectly suits his closing style if he's retained ability.

watchPoints.text: Chicago Storm's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes will compromise his pace advantage and open up the race
Ghasham's ability to get competitive position from hold-up style if pace is genuinely crawling early
Bentley Road's actual running style becomes clear in early stages given uncertain tactical approach
Cross Of Redmoor shows any signs of needed run or ring-rustiness given the extended absence
How aggressively the prominent runners position themselves behind Chicago Storm in the opening half-mile

races.name: Lisa Bond Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Miss Maverick
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with solid recent form but faces multiple prominent rivals wanting forward positions

runners_data.name: Cannock Park
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 217-day layoff which raises fitness concerns despite trainer having runners ready

runners_data.name: Imperial Data
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace setup with topspeed headgear potentially providing extra gear when needed

runners_data.name: Johnson's Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner faces difficult task with limited pace scenario but trainer in decent recent form

runners_data.name: Sunset Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with pull-up headgear stepping down significantly in grade from recent efforts

runners_data.name: Perseus Way
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 35-day break on flat, needs strong pace collapse to be effective

runners_data.name: Passing Diamond
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner stepping up in grade but carries only 150lbs which helps his chances

runners_data.name: Well Educated
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran quick back after 7-day break, needs everything to fall right from back of field

races.paceDynamic: Miss Maverick leads the pace angle as the most natural front runner, with Imperial Data, Cannock Park, Sunset Hill and Passing Diamond all showing prominent tendencies creating a competitive early pace. The lack of genuine hold-up horses means the pace will be solid but not destructive, with multiple horses wanting forward positions through the early stages. Johnson's Blue, Perseus Way and Well Educated as the only hold-up runners will need the pace to collapse late to be effective. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can track the early pace and stay on, rather than hold-up horses who will struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is solid but sustainable with Miss Maverick leading
scenarios.body: The prominent pack of Imperial Data, Cannock Park and Passing Diamond can track into good positions and outfinish the leader, while hold-up horses struggle to close from too far back. This scenario perfectly suits the multiple prominent runners who can position handily without being pressured.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Maverick gets an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old can dictate terms and use her tactical speed to hold off late challengers, especially with her solid recent form. Hold-up horses still face the same closing problem with insufficient pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably strong between multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile allowing hold-up specialists Johnson's Blue and Perseus Way to sweep past tired leaders. This requires the prominent pack to go too hard too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Maverick goes too slow early creating bunching
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any of the prominent runners can win, with tactical positioning more important than pure pace. Even the hold-up horses get into contention with a crawling early pace.

watchPoints.text: Miss Maverick must be watched for how easily she gets to the front - if unchallenged early she becomes very dangerous
Imperial Data's headgear change to topspeed could signal connections expect improved performance after recent moderate run
Cannock Park returning after 217 days needs monitoring for fitness levels in the market and early positioning
Perseus Way switching back from flat racing after 35 days could show improved jumping rhythm if ready to go
The early pace battle between multiple prominent runners will determine whether hold-up horses get into contention

races.paceDynamic: Campaign Trail and Billy Boi Blue will set a measured pace early, with Supreme Yeats, Wee Alki and Divilabother tracking prominently behind. The two front-runners have sustainable pace styles and won't create excessive early fractions over this staying trip. The race will develop into a tactical affair with the pace building gradually through the second half as the prominent brigade apply pressure. This setup clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can control their position without being set alight by frantic early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If Campaign Trail and Billy Boi Blue maintain control through halfway and the pace stays reasonable
scenarios.body: The prominent pack of Supreme Yeats, Wee Alki and Divilabother can track the leaders comfortably before launching coordinated challenges from the second-last hurdle. This tactical positioning allows them to conserve energy while staying close enough to strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Flourish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong as the prominent horses jostle for position
scenarios.body: Pinot Rouge and Beny Nahar Road benefit from increased pace as they can settle further back and unleash finishing kicks. The stronger gallop sets up perfectly for their patient tactics and late acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Campaign Trail and Billy Boi Blue establish clear early leads and face minimal pressure
scenarios.body: They can dictate throughout and prove difficult to peg back up the Hexham hill. Their class advantage shows as they control the race from pillar to post without serious interference.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners become overly cautious and create crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn where pure speed matters most. Lets Mingle's uncertain style could prove effective in these circumstances as tactical positioning becomes less relevant.

watchPoints.text: Campaign Trail and Billy Boi Blue could steal a march if they get uncontested leads and face no early pressure
Supreme Yeats has best course form and Skelton strike-rate but needs to overcome 10-year-old stamina questions
Pinot Rouge requires genuinely strong pace to unleash finishing kick but this tactical setup may not provide it
Lets Mingle's style marked as uncertain creates unpredictable element that could disrupt pace calculations
Beny Nahar Road gets significant weight relief at foot of weights but needs others to ensure strong gallop

races.name: Stan Hayhurst Memorial Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: A Year Older
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist fresh from hurdles win but needs strong pace to unleash finishing kick over this staying trip.

runners_data.name: Killybegs Jet Lady
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with decent form who should get soft lead but stamina query at this extended distance.

runners_data.name: Passengerontheship
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form for in-form yard, suited by good ground and likely to track early leaders.

runners_data.name: Dr Shirocco
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner who stays well but lacks the class edge of main rivals at this level.

runners_data.name: Croagh Patrick
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 21-day break with claiming rider taking valuable weight allowance.

runners_data.name: She Won't Mind
runners_data.note: Needs to bounce back from poor last run but has shown ability to stay this trip in better efforts.

runners_data.name: The Kings Soldier
runners_data.note: Young progressive type who stays well but 7lb claiming rider suggests connections unsure of winning chance.

races.paceDynamic: Killybegs Jet Lady will take this race forward from the outset, with Passengerontheship and Dr Shirocco likely to track her in the early stages. The pace should be sustainable rather than frenetic given the lack of other confirmed front-runners, allowing the leaders to dictate terms throughout the 3-mile trip. A Year Older represents the strongest hold-up threat but will need the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick. This tactical scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can position themselves behind Killybegs Jet Lady and strike when the pace lifts, rather than pure hold-up horses who may find insufficient pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Killybegs Jet Lady sets steady fractions and the pace doesn't collapse
scenarios.body: Passengerontheship or Dr Shirocco can track the leader and outstay her in the final half-mile when stamina becomes the deciding factor. The moderate early pace suits horses with tactical speed who don't need a strong gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Killybegs Jet Lady gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Her recent form suggests she's capable of lasting home if allowed to dictate, especially with the step up to 3 miles suiting her stamina reserves. The lack of early pressure allows her to conserve energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early trying to put A Year Older to sleep
scenarios.body: The race sets up perfectly for A Year Older's devastating finishing kick, as he can pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. His recent hurdles win shows he retains that turn of foot when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with no clear leader emerging after the first mile
scenarios.body: Horses like The Kings Soldier or She Won't Mind can benefit from the tactical nature, getting into contention when others are poorly positioned. The race becomes more about who handles the muddling pace rather than pure ability.

watchPoints.text: A Year Older's positioning through the first mile - if he's too far back in a slow pace he won't get the setup needed for his kick.
Killybegs Jet Lady's jumping rhythm early on - any mistakes will compromise her front-running tactics and hand initiative to trackers.
How quickly Passengerontheship moves into a tracking position - his in-form trainer's runners have been running with more urgency recently.
The pace through the middle mile - if it becomes pedestrian the hold-up horses will struggle to make their ground tell.
Whether any of the outsiders can get competitive early - a faster pace would bring stamina more into play for the closers.
